fail_closed_conditions: corpus integration summary must report PASS
external validation integration summary must report PASS
checked-in dashboard and release-evidence schema anchors must exist
public reporting cannot promote quarantined or blocked evidence into claim-ready status
fail_closed_behavior_boundary: provisional, blocked, quarantined, missing-upstream, report-only, generated-only, generated-report-only, dashboard-only, scorecard-only, badge-only, tmp-artifact-only, workflow-label-only, fallback, shim, old-mode, compatibility, and unsupported public claims cannot be promoted to claim-ready support

stability_boundary_policy.primary_axis: behavior owner before public status, badge, score band, scoring weight, deduction, minimum claimability row, fail-closed condition, or claim language
stability_boundary_policy.support_authority: claim-ready status requires e2e owner assignment backed by upstream evidence owners and fail-closed stability rules
stability_boundary_policy.retired_surface_rule: provisional-as-claim-ready, blocked-as-claim-ready, quarantined promotion, missing-upstream evidence, report-only rows, generated-only rows, dashboard-only rows, scorecard-only rows, badge-only rows, fallback rows, shim rows, old-mode rows, compatibility rows, and unsupported rows are provenance, canonical rejection, strict-error, or absent-support evidence

capability_truth_rules: claim-ready means every upstream evidence owner reported PASS and no hard blocks remain
provisional means publishable with explicit deductions and caution status
blocked means the public artifact must report blocked and cannot imply conformance readiness

claim_language.claim-ready: Objective-C 3 public conformance is claim-ready only when the scorecard has no hard blocks.
claim_language.provisional: Objective-C 3 public conformance is publishable with caution when non-blocking deductions remain.
claim_language.blocked: Objective-C 3 public conformance is blocked when required upstream evidence or schema anchors are missing.
